goal: Invalidate file Evidence after authoritative Asset deletion or quarantine, recompute affected deliverables, enforce live Evidence validity in node and project guards, and implement separate project completion and archive transitions.
dependencies: existing Asset/Evidence authority and security-domain boundary
proposedSlices: P0-05A-T2c-1 Asset deletion/quarantine to Evidence invalidation, deliverable recomputation, and live node-guard revalidation
P0-05A-T2c-2 Project completion/archive lifecycle and guard

productDecisions.projectLifecycle: completed and archived are separate; only the current active PM may execute either transition; completion requires every non-deleted node completed and live Evidence validity; archive additionally requires no active migration, no unpublished project-scoped outbox, no non-terminal authority-changing project job, and freezes ordinary product writes
productDecisions.evidenceRecomputation: Move a non-waived deliverable to evidence_due only when remaining valid Evidence is below minCount; waived remains unchanged; clear canonical acceptance fields while preserving immutable action history
productDecisions.completedNode: Do not automatically reopen a completed node; invalid Evidence blocks later project completion/archive; mandatory security quarantine remains allowed after archive and does not implicitly unarchive
productDecisions.quarantineAuthority: available to quarantined is allowed only for a trusted scanner/security service identity with a non-empty reason
productDecisions.deleteAuthority: Only the current active PM or current active owner-node leader with target-domain permission may delete, with a non-empty reason; uploader status alone grants no delete authority

nextAction: First implement and independently review the Cindy Control Plane MVP from docs/development/cindy-orchestration.md. Do not start the T2c product-code Builder before that automation slice closes.
